notes: The site now brands itself 'Enchanted Hills Napa' (EHN), a property of LightHouse for the Blind and Visually Impaired, and runs as a social enterprise: summer camp for blind/low-vision campers, off-season rentals for meetings, weddings, wellness retreats and individual 'stays'. Rebuilt after the 2017 fire: new Forest Commons dining/meeting hall, Hillside Village (Hillside Apartment + Casitas 1-8, with heating/AC and ADA bathrooms), Lakeside cabins 1-11 with shared baths, Forest Village cabins, plus safari-style tents and yurts; the accommodations page notes many sleeping spaces and bathrooms are shared 'reflecting the traditional camp experience'. Site lists ~5 miles of on-site trails, a lake with fountain, pool, and redwood-grove yoga deck. Heads-up for image use: several large hero images on the site (vineyards, hot-air balloons, wine glasses, massage close-ups) are generic stock and were deliberately NOT used; everything kept here shows EHN facilities per the site's own alt text.
